airbnb-experiences-photo.name: Airbnb Experiences: host a photo walk or shoot
airbnb-experiences-photo.deadlineText: Always open; review takes a few weeks
airbnb-experiences-photo.fee: You set a price per guest; Airbnb keeps 20%
airbnb-experiences-photo.who: Experience and a portfolio that Airbnb reviews; liability insurance; a waiting list in busy cities
airbnb-experiences-photo.offer: You run a set outing for small groups, for example a photo walk through Rotterdam with portraits. Paid the day after
airbnb-experiences-photo.label: confirmed

airbnb-services-photography.name: Airbnb Services: photo shoots booked by guests
airbnb-services-photography.deadlineText: Always open; review takes a few weeks
airbnb-services-photography.fee: You set your price; Airbnb keeps 15%
airbnb-services-photography.who: Experience and a portfolio that Airbnb reviews; liability insurance for your business; it may ask for a licence
airbnb-services-photography.offer: Guests staying in a city book a shoot with you through Airbnb. You are paid the day after the shoot
airbnb-services-photography.label: confirmed

freelance-nl-dog-products-2026-09.name: Photographer and video maker for dog products
freelance-nl-dog-products-2026-09.who: A free account on Freelance.nl to respond; the work is on site in Amersfoort
freelance-nl-dog-products-2026-09.offer: Photos and video that show a product for dogs and how it works; 10 to 20 hours a week
freelance-nl-dog-products-2026-09.label: confirmed

freelance-nl.name: Freelance.nl: Dutch assignments for photo and video
freelance-nl.fee: Each client sets it; many posts show no rate
freelance-nl.who: A free account to respond; your KVK number to invoice; most posts are in Dutch
freelance-nl.offer: Dutch companies post freelance assignments and you respond with your rate
freelance-nl.label: confirmed

influee.name: Influee: short videos for brands
influee.fee: Examples on the page: 20 to 68 euro per video to the creator
influee.who: No follower count is asked on the page; you film at home with products sent to you
influee.offer: Brands order short product videos; over 4,000 creators in the Netherlands are on it
influee.label: confirmed

malt-nl.name: Malt: freelance profiles for Dutch companies
malt-nl.fee: Dutch video profiles show about 400 to 650 euro a day, as a reader reported
malt-nl.who: A KVK number; a profile with work samples
malt-nl.offer: Companies search for a freelancer and book through Malt, which takes a share
malt-nl.label: claimed

snappr.name: Snappr: booked shoots, new in the Netherlands
snappr.who: Paid experience, Lightroom, and a portfolio judged by other photographers; a reader says about 5 in 100 get in
snappr.offer: The platform sells shoots to companies and sends you the job
snappr.label: claimed

splento.name: Splento: on-demand shoots for companies
splento.deadlineText: Always open; they answer in a few days
splento.fee: You state your own hourly and day rate on the form; no pay is promised
splento.who: A portfolio or Instagram, your camera list, the languages you speak
splento.offer: A company that sends photographers and videographers to client shoots in over 50 countries; the Netherlands is on its list
splento.label: confirmed

trustoo.name: Trustoo: Dutch clients asking for a videographer
trustoo.fee: Clients are told 120 to 160 euro an hour; a wedding film 1,000 to 3,000 euro
trustoo.who: A registered business; the site and its clients are Dutch; what a listing costs is not shown
trustoo.offer: A comparison site with over 650 videographers, where clients ask for quotes
trustoo.label: confirmed

twine.name: Twine: freelance marketplace
twine.fee: Photographers in the Netherlands list 400 to 925 euro a day; Twine keeps 0 to 10%
twine.offer: Clients post projects and you pitch for them
twine.label: confirmed
